Discover how

Better life,longer living.

We exist to encourage better, longer living through wiser choices. Longevity is not just about living longer—it’s about living better. Better lifestyles. Better futures. We believe well-being is not only about the body but also concerns the mind and community. Sharing quality time with our loved ones is what makes life worth living. We thrive on what’s meaningful: from meaningful relationships to meaningful work, meaningful actions and meaningful lives. From the Mediterranean Sea to the world, our movement seeks to seize life’s full potential.

Creatingthe well-being ecosystem

Our operational strength is what drives our ability to bring quality well-being solutions to the world, enabling us to discover, design, source, distribute, market, and sell top well-being products globally:

  • Through our robust worldwide network of suppliers, distributors and partners, combined with an optimized supply chain and quality control practices.

  • Our dedicated teams create impactful brand narratives and visual identities that engage with our community. Our innovative content and targeted campaigns nourish our products for our loyal customers.

  • With presence in over 12 countries, we leverage multiple online platforms (including web, Amazon, Walmart, Decathlon, and TikTok Shop) and offline retail locations to expand our market reach and drive growth.

  • With a seasoned M&A team, we excel in acquiring and integrating brands, creating synergies, and aligning strategic objectives to enhance our portfolio and expand our community impact.

  • Our integrated technology provides us with critical insights to improve our products and achieve top-notch standards in the market.

  • Our in-house legal team ensures all our products are fully compliant across the US, Europe and Asia.

  • Our in-house team of nutritionists and market researchers identifies emerging trends and develops cutting-edge products, launching new solutions in under six weeks.

Our cultureThe Yaber spirit

The Yaber is here for the journey. It means embracing a vibrant and mindful approach to life and work. We’re a tight-knit crew, where shared passion and mutual respect spark creativity and drive. Our diverse, global team thrives in a dynamic, inclusive space where every Yaber can grow, both personally and professionally. Here, purpose meets passion. Together we’re building something greater.

The Yaba formula:

Global talent

With a team representing a wide range of nationalities on board that fuel our creativity and innovation.

Generational mix

With three generations working together in a dynamic environment where experience and fresh perspectives thrive.

Embracing diversity

Flexibility & balance

Generous time off

  • 1 Wellbeing Day Off per month→ 12 days/year
  • 3 Additional Vacation Days(beyond the 22 days mandated by the collective agreement)
  • Your Birthday Off→ 1 day

Understanding GLP-1 : What It Is and How Nutrition Can Support It

GLP-1 is a key hormone involved in appetite regulation, satiety, and metabolic health. While medications such as Ozempic® and Mounjaro® work by targeting GLP-1 pathways directly, lifestyle factors—including diet, fibre intake, gut health, and specific nutritional ingredients—can help support the body's natural metabolic processes.
